rule_description: 100% of credit to the earliest eligible touch in the window
100% of credit to the latest eligible touch at or before conversion
Equal credit to every eligible touch in the window
Credit proportional to 0.5^(age_days/7): recent touches weigh more
40% first, 40% last, 20% shared by middle touches (2 touches: 50/50; 1 touch: 100%)
